hero.lead: From domestic collection to global export, Kowa keeps plastics in continuous motion: cleaner supply chains, less waste, and real resource recovery.
hero.body: A Tokyo trading partner since 1994: we buy waste and loss plastics across Japan, regenerate them through our G.P. Polymer line, and trade recycled material, resin, battery-pack support, and industrial machinery worldwide.

business.title: WHAT IS KOWA'S BUSINESS?
business.intro: Kowa runs a resource-circulation trading model centered on plastics recycling, industrial support, and cross-border supply operations.

flowPhases.title: Purchase & Collection
flowPhases.step: Purchase and collect production-loss materials and waste plastic.
flowPhases.detail: The source flow starts with intake from resin production loss, waste plastic, mixed plastic, and processing-loss material before the line moves into sorting.

flowPhases.title: Sorting & Dismantling
flowPhases.step: Sort and dismantle by resin, ingredient blend, and material condition.
flowPhases.detail: Kowa separates incoming material before processing so different resin streams and blended inputs can move into the correct crushing and regeneration path.

flowPhases.title: Crushing & Regeneration
flowPhases.step: Crush, compress, blend, and regenerate into reusable raw material.
flowPhases.detail: The documented process centers on crushing machines, compression equipment, and ribbon-mixer handling that convert plastic inputs back into reusable raw material.

flowPhases.title: Export / Domestic Sales
flowPhases.step: Route regenerated material to export, overseas supply, and domestic sales.
flowPhases.detail: The final stage is outbound circulation: export lanes, overseas supply, and domestic sales after material has been processed into usable feedstock.

companyProfile.title: Vision
companyProfile.summary: A world where nothing of value is wasted. Kowa exists to keep plastics and resources in continuous circulation, collecting, regenerating, and trading materials across borders so that every supply chain we serve becomes cleaner, more circular, and more resilient for the generations ahead.
companyProfile.introTitle: From domestic collection to global circulation.
companyProfile.introBody: The legacy profile frames Kowa as a plastics-centered trading and processing company: collect domestically, regenerate where needed, and return usable resources to industrial supply chains.

statements.text: 当社は生活環境で生まれる様々な廃プラスチックを国内で収集・加工し、主に東南アジア諸国へ輸出しています。輸出したプラスチックは再加工され、様々な製品となって世界へ出荷されます。また、再生工場であるジーピーポリマー株式会社を設立・稼働し、輸出だけでなく国内での再生加工にも力を入れています。企業から排出される廃プラスチックは、現地での雇用拡大や生活の安定にもつながっており、限りあるエナジー資源を有効に扱い、やさしい環境へ還元することを目指しています。

We collect plastics domestically and export them overseas. The exported plastics are reprocessed into various products and shipped worldwide. Kowa has established and operates a crushing factory, G.P. Polymer, and is also focusing on remanufacturing in Japan. Loss materials and waste plastics purchased from companies are crushed and incorporated into recycling so valuable resources can circulate. We aim to use limited global resources effectively and pass this circulation on to the next generation.

focusCards.title: Collection and export lanes
focusCards.detail: Domestic collection and preprocessing are tied directly to overseas circulation, especially across Southeast Asian markets.

focusCards.title: Domestic regeneration capability
focusCards.detail: Kowa complements export activity with in-country crushing and regeneration through G.P. Polymer and the Gunma processing line.

focusCards.title: Resource-minded execution
focusCards.detail: The profile emphasizes careful use of limited resources, customer-first handling, and a practical circular-economy mindset.

companyProfile.timelineIntro: The chronology shows Kowa evolving from a trading company into a warehouse, factory, and large-scale plastics processing operator.

timeline.title: Foundation

timeline.title: Corporate reorganization
timeline.detail: Capital increased to 10 million yen and the company reorganized as a joint-stock company.

timeline.detail: A self-operated Gunma distribution warehouse started operations as the North-Kanto base.

timeline.title: Tokai warehouse start
timeline.detail: Fuji distribution warehouse began operating as the Tokai regional base.

timeline.title: Gunma processing factory
timeline.detail: The Gunma processing factory was completed and the first large crushing and grinding line was introduced.

timeline.title: Mixer installation
timeline.detail: A large industrial mixer was added to the processing setup.

timeline.title: Second crushing line
timeline.detail: A second large crushing and grinding machine was introduced.

whatWeDo.subtitle: Kowa's trading lines

categories.plastics: Domestic collection through export: waste and loss plastics are sorted, crushed, and regenerated into pellet-form material through our G.P. Polymer line.
categories.generalGoods: Cross-border sourcing and distribution of general merchandise, moved through the same trading and logistics network as our plastics business.
categories.foods: Trade support for food-related goods, handled with the same disciplined sourcing and shipment coordination as our other lines.
categories.ffe: Furniture, fixtures, and equipment sourced and distributed for commercial and industrial buyers.
categories.timber: Solid Myanmar teak flooring, milled at a Yangon partner factory from government-licensed logs and imported direct.
